method: Each withheld or blocked holdout photograph was opened and looked at by the person recording it. A description is bound to the SHA-256 of the bytes it describes; the readiness generator ignores a description whose hash no longer matches the manifest.
summary: None of the 27 shows nudity or sexual content. The 7 blocked photographs are ordinary fashion, wedding, uniform and doll pictures, so the block floor fires on benign input. Six entries are dolls, a rendered avatar or AI-generated portraits rather than photographs of people, which the Openverse query admitted.
